# skill_sorting_files_naming_standard

A directory listing is read by eye before any parser reads it, and every machine sorts it lexicographically — so a name is designed for the order it will land in, on any server, under any locale. *The repository shows the destination, not the road*: the order is designed; the crawler reads against it every controlled file whose row marks it, and gates nothing.

## Naming

- `SORTING-FILES-NAMING-STANDARD-CATEGORY-TOKEN-LEADS`
  - Description: The category token leads a name, so a lexicographic listing groups siblings into one contiguous block.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: The category first, then the detail — `module_*` beside `module_*`, `skill_*` beside `skill_*` — and the token kept inside the folder too, `skills/skill_*.md`, a file being read detached from it.
  - Exception: The ecosystem-fixed names — `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `Dockerfile`, `Makefile`, `README.md`, `__init__.py`, `docker-compose.yml`, `requirements.txt` and the dot-files — which keep their tool's own spelling.
- `SORTING-FILES-NAMING-STANDARD-ZERO-PAD-EVERY-NUMBER`
  - Description: A number in a name is zero-padded, so text order and numeric order are the same order.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: Every numeric slot at the fixed width its grammar states — two digits per slot of `ss-mm-hh-dd-MM` until a real name needs three — so text order equals numeric order and sibling names line up column by column.
  - Exception: none
- `SORTING-FILES-NAMING-STANDARD-A-PATTERN-SORTS-UNDER-EVERY-COLLATION`
  - Description: A sortable pattern builds its order on what every collation agrees on — a leading category token, and digits before letters — never on case or punctuation alone, so it holds under byte order, a UTF-8 locale and a case-insensitive filesystem alike.
  - Scope: `**/*`
  - Expected: The order a pattern promises — the timeframe slots, a zero-padded number, the `<TICKER>_` block of an asset's folder — the same under `LC_COLLATE=C` and under `en_US.UTF-8`.
  - Exception: The ecosystem-fixed names, the orientations `README_module_<name>.md` and `README_sub_module_<subject>.md`, and `<TICKER>_README.md`, which keep their spelling: `<TICKER>_README.md` lists first in its folder under `LC_COLLATE=C` and among the lower-case names under a UTF-8 locale, its `<TICKER>_` block contiguous under both.
- `SORTING-FILES-NAMING-STANDARD-TIMEFRAME-SLOTS`
  - Description: A filesystem name that carries a timeframe writes five fixed slots, finest to coarsest, the active one a padded number and the rest their unit letters.
  - Scope: `**/config.py`, `**/*.py`
  - Expected: `ss-mm-hh-dd-MM` with one slot filled, as `timeframe_slot()` of `module_features/config.py` writes it.
  - Exception: Serialised schema — a family name, a feature id, an artifact key — keeps the compact token, being a contract with the files on disk, and so does the raw store `store/raw_1m/`, the one raw child of `store/`; a partition `timeframe=<tf>/` of a family carries the compact token as its value and a Parquet file inside it carries no slot; a partition of the `catalogue` family carries no timeframe in its columns.
